title: Additional Driver Fee for Each Chargeable Day Where a Waiver Stands on the Agreement
content:
The fee taken for each chargeable day of an agreement on the Car Rental Rate Classes is decided by the protection standing on that agreement together with the vehicle booked.

**The fee schedule.**

| What stands on the agreement | The fee for each chargeable day |
|---|---|
| A collision damage waiver line standing for every booked rental day, and a vehicle booked in a premium, luxury or van class | 16.00 |
| A collision damage waiver line standing for every booked rental day, and a vehicle booked in any other class | 9.50 |
| The waiver not standing for every booked rental day | The rate class's own additional driver fee |

**What "standing for every booked rental day" means.** The collision damage waiver lines raised on the rental's own ledger are counted, and the waiver stands for every booked rental day where those lines are at least as many as the booked rental days of the agreement. Where they are fewer, the waiver does not stand for every booked rental day, whatever the reason, and the third row of the schedule governs.

**The vehicle classes named.** Only a premium, a luxury or a van class carries the fee of 16.00. Every other vehicle class booked, the waiver standing for every booked rental day, carries 9.50.

**Positive and negative cases on hypothetical agreements.**

*A hypothetical agreement booking 5 rental days with 5 waiver lines on its ledger, the vehicle booked in a luxury class.* The waiver stands for every booked rental day and the class is one of the three named, so each chargeable day is taken at 16.00.

*The same agreement with the vehicle booked in a compact class.* The waiver still stands for every booked rental day, but the class is not one of the three named, so each chargeable day is taken at 9.50.

*A hypothetical agreement booking 5 rental days with 4 waiver lines on its ledger.* The waiver does not stand for every booked rental day, and each chargeable day is taken at the additional driver fee published for the rate class booked, whatever the vehicle class.
